scientific_integrity: Real and complex Schur-multiplier norms agree for the specified symmetric sign matrices. The exact Fourier formula and six-residue second-order asymptotic are proved analytically. Numerical checks are finite corroboration. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only simple unit-edge prism graphs and their specified sign masks are covered.
The six-phase asymptotic does not classify all finite adjacent monotonicity comparisons.
The classical symmetry-to-trace reduction and standard Fourier techniques are prior art; a historical equivalent oscillatory formula is a residual priority risk.
title: Six-residue finite-size oscillations for signed-prism Schur norms
